assumptions: 1. Effect.timeout("2 seconds") puts a TimeoutException (with _tag: "TimeoutException") on the E channel, making it visible to Schedule.while. 2. FetchHttpClient.Fetch is a Context.Tag for the underlying fetch function, swappable via Layer.succeed as shown for FetchHttpClient.RequestInit. 3. HttpClientResponse.matchStatus receives all status codes without needing filterStatusOk applied first—the base client returns any-status responses. 4. Schedule.while receives { input: E } where E is the error type, as shown in the retry-with-test-clock recipe. 5. Schedule.upTo({ times: 3 }) gives at most 3 schedule recurrences (= 3 retries after the initial attempt, 4 total). 6. HttpClientError from transport failures has _tag: "HttpClientError" and does not match the retry predicate, so it propagates unretried.
